sources.title: PhantomPlay Unreal flagship project
sources.summary: Canonical Unreal source project for the three distinct PhantomPlay flagships.
sources.practical_use: Search this source before adding duplicate flagship routing, gameplay foundations, or build targets.
sources.caution: Source presence is not compile, playtest, visual, performance, or packaged-build proof.

sources.title: Unreal Engine documentation
sources.summary: Primary engine documentation for Unreal Engine workflows, systems, APIs, and platform requirements.
sources.practical_use: Consult before substantial Unreal implementation, plugin, packaging, or engine-version decisions.
sources.caution: Use documentation matching the installed engine version and verify plugin-specific terms.

sources.title: Unreal Insights Trace Quick Start
sources.summary: Official trace workflow for collecting and analyzing Unreal runtime performance evidence.
sources.practical_use: Capture representative packaged or development sessions before and after systemic performance changes.
sources.caution: Tool availability is not a performance capture; traces must come from the actual gameplay scenario.

sources.title: Unreal Engine performance profiling tools
sources.summary: Official guidance for measuring CPU, GPU, frame-time, rendering, and memory behavior in Unreal projects.
sources.practical_use: Use alongside Unreal Insights and external GPU tools for measured optimization.
sources.caution: Editor numbers can mislead; final conclusions require a representative target build.

sources.title: Enhanced Input in Unreal Engine
sources.license: Epic Games documentation and Unreal Engine terms
sources.summary: Official input system for actions, mapping contexts, contextual controls, remapping, modifiers, and triggers.
sources.practical_use: Use for game-specific control maps and user-remappable desktop input.
sources.caution: The flagship source currently declares the plugin but still requires compiled input validation.

sources.title: Navigation System in Unreal Engine
sources.license: Epic Games documentation and Unreal Engine terms
sources.summary: Official tiled navigation-mesh, query-cost, dynamic generation, and avoidance documentation.
sources.practical_use: Use as the engine baseline before adopting a custom large-army navigation architecture.
sources.caution: A conventional NavMesh baseline does not prove formation quality or target-scale performance.

sources.title: Behavior Trees in Unreal Engine
sources.license: Epic Games documentation and Unreal Engine terms
sources.summary: Official event-driven Behavior Tree and Blackboard system for Unreal NPC decision-making.
sources.practical_use: Use where inspectable behavior graphs outperform ad-hoc per-frame decision code.
sources.caution: Behavior Trees are one option; simple deterministic state machines may remain clearer for narrow units.

sources.title: Niagara visual effects in Unreal Engine
sources.license: Epic Games documentation and Unreal Engine terms
sources.summary: Official Unreal VFX system documentation for systems, emitters, modules, events, and simulation workflows.
sources.practical_use: Use for readable impacts, projectiles, atmosphere, destruction accents, and game-specific effects.
sources.caution: VFX completeness and performance require authored assets, budgeted emitters, and target-build inspection.

sources.title: Lyra Sample Game
sources.license: Unreal Engine EULA and sample-specific terms
sources.summary: Epic sample game demonstrating modular shooter, input, animation, UI, ability, networking, and VFX patterns.
sources.practical_use: Study narrow architecture patterns for PhantomStrike without importing the sample wholesale.
sources.caution: Lyra is a learning resource, not a drop-in PhantomStrike implementation; ownership and identity must remain distinct.

sources.title: PhantomPlay Unity 6 shared project
sources.summary: Retained Unity migration source and compatibility fixture for unrelated Unity uploads; it is not the runtime for the three Unreal flagships.
sources.practical_use: Use for licensed migration evidence and to preserve PhantomPlay Unity adapter coverage.
sources.caution: Do not register this project as the PhantomStrike, Phantom Ages, or Phantom Legends runtime.

sources.title: Unity 6 Manual
sources.summary: Primary engine documentation for Unity 6 behavior, workflows, supported APIs, and platform requirements.
sources.practical_use: Consult before substantial Unity implementation or package changes.
sources.caution: Verify the exact package version documentation when package APIs are involved.

sources.title: Unity AI Navigation 2.0
sources.summary: Official high-level NavMesh components for edit-time and runtime navigation, dynamic obstacles, and links.
sources.practical_use: Use as the conventional baseline before choosing a custom large-crowd navigation architecture.
sources.caution: A NavMesh baseline is not proof that per-agent navigation will scale to hundreds of units.

sources.title: Unity Profiler
sources.summary: Built-in frame and subsystem profiler for measuring runtime behavior instead of optimizing by intuition.
sources.practical_use: Capture representative play sessions and retain evidence before and after performance changes.
sources.caution: Editor profiling adds overhead; development-player captures are required for final performance conclusions.

sources.title: Unity Profile Analyzer
sources.summary: Official package for aggregating and comparing profiler data over many frames.
sources.practical_use: Compare representative captures before and after systemic performance work.
sources.caution: Pin a Unity 6000.3-compatible package version before adding it to production.

sources.title: Unity Memory Profiler
sources.summary: Official detailed memory snapshot and comparison package.
sources.practical_use: Use for native/managed ownership, oversized content, leaked references, and allocation investigation.
sources.caution: Pin a Unity 6000.3-compatible package version and compare equivalent gameplay states.

sources.title: Unity Frame Debugger
sources.summary: Built-in step-by-step rendering event inspection.
sources.practical_use: Use to explain unexpected passes, draw calls, ordering, transparency, and batching behavior.
sources.caution: It diagnoses rendering sequence; it does not replace a GPU profiler.

sources.title: Unity URP Rendering Debugger
sources.summary: Official URP pipeline inspection for lighting, materials, rendering features, buffers, and statistics.
sources.practical_use: Use after a render-pipeline decision and before guessing at visual or overdraw problems.
sources.caution: Requires URP; the current PhantomPlay Unity project has not yet selected URP or HDRP.

sources.title: Unity-Technologies verified GitHub organization
sources.summary: Verified first-party organization and the first GitHub discovery stop for Unity implementations.
sources.practical_use: Search here before evaluating unknown community alternatives.
sources.caution: Official ownership does not guarantee that every repository is current or production-ready.

sources.title: Unity Input System
sources.license: Unity Companion License with sample-specific third-party terms
sources.summary: Official package source and samples for actions, devices, rebinding, on-screen controls, and multiplayer input.
sources.practical_use: Extract action-map and rebinding patterns; consume released package versions through Package Manager.
sources.caution: Do not integrate the development branch directly into production without sandbox validation.

sources.title: Unity Addressables Sample
sources.license: Per-repository Unity license; verify LICENSE before extraction
sources.summary: Official examples for asset references, additive scenes, lifecycle management, and content loading.
sources.practical_use: Extract lifecycle and reference-counting patterns, then test them in an isolated project.
sources.caution: The repository explicitly describes its projects as examples that are not guaranteed for a production situation.

sources.title: Unity DOTS and ECS samples
sources.summary: Official DOTS 101, Entities, Physics, Netcode, graphics, content management, and UI samples.
sources.practical_use: Use as a reference when measurement shows a data-oriented implementation may be warranted.
sources.caution: Current samples target Unity 6.2 and package 1.4; PhantomPlay is on 6000.3.18f1 and must verify compatibility before adoption.

sources.title: Unity Graphics repository
sources.license: Unity Companion License and third-party notices
sources.summary: Official Scriptable Render Pipeline source, tests, examples, and graphics package development repository.
sources.practical_use: Consult package docs first, then extract narrow rendering patterns from matching release tags.
sources.caution: Repository branches can be ahead of released packages and are not drop-in game projects.

sources.title: Unity ML-Agents Toolkit
unity_versions: Unity 6000.0 or later for current development installation guidance
sources.summary: Official toolkit and example environments for training and evaluating agents in Unity simulations.
sources.practical_use: Use for experiments where learning has measurable value, including bot training and automated gameplay evaluation.
sources.caution: Prefer deterministic AI when state machines, utility AI, behavior trees, GOAP, or scripted systems solve the problem more simply.

sources.title: Unity UI Toolkit manual code examples
sources.summary: Official, focused examples corresponding to UI Toolkit manual workflows.
sources.practical_use: Extract focused UI patterns instead of copying a complete sample application.
sources.caution: Validate each example against the exact Unity and UI Toolkit version in production.

sources.title: Unity FPS Sample (legacy reference)
sources.summary: Complete first-party FPS reference with client/server and gameplay systems, retained only as historical design evidence.
sources.practical_use: Study architecture selectively; do not import or upgrade wholesale.
sources.caution: The repository is explicitly unmaintained, targets Unity 2018.3, and requires Git LFS. Integration score must be low.

sources.title: Unity RTS Selection reference
sources.summary: Small raycast-based unit-selection reference with additive and subtractive selection behavior.
sources.practical_use: Review the narrow selection pattern only after official and internal systems are checked.
sources.caution: Maintenance and modern Unity compatibility require dependency-sandbox verification.

sources.title: Terraced Terrain Generator
sources.summary: Open procedural terrain package with deterministic generation, samples, and reduced-allocation native data structures.
sources.practical_use: Study generation and allocation patterns; benchmark before adopting its aesthetic or mesh format.
sources.caution: It targets terraced terrain and should not define PhantomPlay's final world style.

sources.title: Continuum Crowds
sources.owner: Adrien Treuille, Seth Cooper, and Zoran Popovic
sources.license: Paper access only; implementation and code licensing are separate
sources.summary: Real-time crowd model using a dynamic potential field to combine global navigation and moving obstacles.
sources.practical_use: Inform large-crowd prototypes and benchmark design; translate the method rather than copying unavailable code.
sources.caution: A paper result is not a production Unity implementation and must be profiled in PhantomPlay's actual scenarios.

sources.title: Optimal Reciprocal Collision Avoidance
sources.owner: Jur van den Berg, Stephen J. Guy, Jamie Snape, Ming C. Lin, and Dinesh Manocha
sources.license: Paper access only; RVO2 implementation license must be checked separately
sources.summary: Formal reciprocal collision-avoidance method that reduces each agent's action selection to a low-dimensional linear program.
sources.practical_use: Evaluate as local avoidance around a separate global navigation solution.
sources.caution: Licensing and practical behavior of any code implementation must be reviewed independently.

sources.title: Unity: A General Platform for Intelligent Agents
sources.license: arXiv paper terms; toolkit code is Apache-2.0
sources.summary: Research basis for using Unity as a configurable platform for visually, physically, and socially complex learning environments.
sources.practical_use: Use to frame measurable ML experiments, not as justification to replace deterministic game AI.
sources.caution: The publication predates Unity 6 APIs; current package documentation remains authoritative for implementation.

sources.title: Unity Netcode for GameObjects
sources.license: Unity Companion License and third-party notices
sources.summary: Official high-level networking SDK for GameObject and MonoBehaviour workflows.
sources.practical_use: Include in requirement-specific networking comparisons; do not select it solely because it is official.
sources.caution: Prediction, rollback, scale, hosting, and dedicated-server requirements must be tested before architecture commitment.

sources.title: Quaternius CC0 game asset packs
sources.summary: Properly licensed foundation assets already represented in the PhantomPlay Unity asset registry.
sources.practical_use: Use as foundations where appropriate, retain license evidence, and perform a project-specific art-direction pass.
sources.caution: Do not let a source pack become the final undifferentiated PhantomPlay aesthetic.
